per_sentence.sentence: S1. For some goings-on, what makes a difference to them is in part their own doing: they hold to something, register some things, act by distinctions.
per_sentence.grade: a theorem states part of it
per_sentence.by: ReadingLoop.sensed_alike_iff (ReadingLoop.lean:442): for every blanketed law (Blanket.lean:92: the internal and active parts move from the internal, sensory and active; the sensory and external from the sensory, active and external), from one internal, sensory and active start, two worlds give the same sensed course through step n exactly as long as, at each step before n, they answer alike the act taken at the value sensed. ReadingLoop.alike_of_kept (:508; the bounded form alike_within :478): with equality of sensed values decided, if at every step any answer of the second world that differs from the first's breaks a task K, and K holds at every step from one on in the second world, the values sensed agree at every step. Untested.floor_forgoes (:889) is its case for every formation on two built worlds. Blanket.agent_through_sensory (Blanket.lean:129): the inside is reached only through what is sensed.
per_sentence.handed_in: The four step functions of the law (how the inside updates, how the act is chosen, what the world answers, how it moves) and the task K. Nothing forms them.
per_sentence.say_it_so: The Lean is sharper. Which differences in the world can reach a loop depends on what it does: two worlds stay alike to it for as long as they answer alike the acts it takes. And where a difference shows only by breaking what the loop holds to, a loop that keeps holding never meets it.

per_sentence.sentence: S2. Holding to something, registering, and acting by distinctions are goings-on like the rest.
per_sentence.grade: a theorem states part of it
per_sentence.by: Registering and revising: ReadingLoop.Loop.law (ReadingLoop.lean:575) is one blanketed law whose internal part is the candidates kept and the last value sensed with the act taken; Loop.kept_iff (:589): from a start with candidates listed and nothing yet answered, a candidate is kept at configuration n + 1 exactly where it was listed and predicted, at each step before n, the value sensed after it (equality of sensed values decided). A reading derived and not supplied: ReadingLoop.possible_kept (:329) and possible_least (:334): with the state the history of acts and values sensed, the worlds possible after a history are kept by recording and are the least reading so kept that holds at the starts. Who reads, in the state: ReaderRebuilding.St and step (ReaderRebuilding.lean:82, :119), with the family law «以储买时当且仅当取于储» (:462). What a fast level goes by, in the state: Pace.paced (Pace.lean:112). What is held to, in the state, in one module outside the five families: ListingValuation.joint (ListingValuation.lean:1847), internal_step (:1855), through_sensed (:1906).
per_sentence.handed_in: The list of candidates, predict and choose (in the witness a ranking of values); the world, the sense map and the starts; the reader's span, count, set level and source; Pace's h and the schedule of reading steps; ListingValuation's revalue, the holder's schedule of acts, the scale and the reference. What a loop holds to (m, s, K, a ranking, values) and the distinction it acts by (a lumping π, thresholds) are parameters in every module of the family. ReadingLoop's head note (lines 122 to 123) says it leaves out how candidates are proposed and a formation's revising its own order.
per_sentence.say_it_so: Registering and revising are already one law with the acting. Holding to something and the distinction acted by are not goings-on in this family: they are handed in, except the valuation of ListingValuation, whose update is handed in. The Lean also says something S2 does not: a reading is kept up out of something. In ReaderRebuilding it is units that age and are rebuilt from the level they keep.

per_sentence.sentence: S3. The three can come apart: something registered and not held to.
per_sentence.grade: a theorem states part of it
per_sentence.by: Learning.state_apart_of_acts_apart (Unread.lean:139) and coupling_apart_of_state_apart (:145): for fixed maps from what couples in, to a state, to an act, acts that differ at two occasions come from states that differ, and those from couplings that differ. Cue.apart_with_content_alike (:187) is the kept witness that neither converse holds (its docstring: detected and not acted on; detectable and not detected). One built course for 'registered and not held to': HeldForReading.SignLoop.refuted_senses_stop (HeldForReading.lean:1317), refuted_drops (:1324), refuted_goes_on (:1332): listing only 'going on gains', holding first where going on loses, the loop senses the stop at step one, drops its only candidate at step two, and goes on from step three. Beside them ReadingLoop.Untested.model_or_order (ReadingLoop.lean:974): a loop keeping both candidates under one ranking and a loop keeping the true candidate under the reversed ranking sense and act alike at every step.
per_sentence.handed_in: The three maps (coupling, state, act); the listing; in the built course the default that the loop goes on when no candidate is kept (said in refuted_goes_on's docstring).
per_sentence.say_it_so: The Lean's three are what couples in, what that changes inside, and what is then done; holding to something is not one of them. They come apart one way only: a loop cannot act on a difference that made none inside it, and nothing differs inside it that did not couple in. And from one course, 'not registered' and 'registered, held otherwise' need not be told apart (model_or_order).

per_sentence.sentence: S4. Some conditions hold of a loop whether or not it draws any distinction there: below its need it stops, and below some level what it lives on does not come back.
per_sentence.grade: a theorem states part of it
per_sentence.by: For a loop that reads, both clauses in one family of models: ReaderRebuilding.«读者绝则无储» (ReaderRebuilding.lean:386): where the reader is rebuilt from the level and at least one unit is wanted, if the reader is gone after a step the level is 0. «取于储者绝而不复» (:404): for that reader the state 'level 0, no reader' is closed under every branch, the supply on or off. cut_empty_end (:374): with an empty stock it ends at its span under a cut. None of the three has a premise on the set level m, which is the distinction this reader acts by. Speaking to the first clause from another side: Reading.RespondsBelow (Reading.lean:210), supported_of_responds (:225), requirement_beyond_course (:312): requiring a condition at a need is defined as the exchange's own response (under every history differing at most in that level at that step, with the level below the need, it does not exchange); two laws generate one course from one start, and the formation requires its condition at every step under one and at no step under the other.
per_sentence.handed_in: The reader's rule (the order draw, read, age, rebuild; span, count, set level, source; one unit drawn a step). In Reading: which law of exchange holds, that an exchange responds to any condition, and the need at which it responds (its head note, lines 73 to 75).
per_sentence.say_it_so: The Lean is partly against the wording. In Reading.lean 'below its need it stops' is the loop's own law responding, which is a distinction it acts by, and no course shows whether it does. A law that does not respond does not stop: it goes on taking, and the rest of the whole supplies the difference or the course is not feasible (rest_idle_iff_feasible, Reading.lean:252). What holds whatever the loop reads is narrower: what it takes has to be there, and in the reader's family, once what rebuilds the reading is gone it does not come back.

per_sentence.sentence: S5. The gap can open in three places: at what is not registered, at what is registered and not held to, and at what is held to and cannot be acted on in time.
per_sentence.grade: a theorem states part of it
per_sentence.by: First place, laws: ReadingSchedule.Flow.Balances.loses_of_unread (ReadingSchedule.lean:690): in a balanced flow, a part that gives nothing to c and takes at least d a step from T until ℓ steps after the first reading of c, under a schedule that leaves c unread for k steps, draws (k + 1 + ℓ)·d, and a formation with significance that the levels without the part admit, requiring c with that level short of its need plus that draw, is lost. Learning.twin_selected (Unread.lean:104). SignLoop.rests_unread and never_senses_stop (HeldForReading.lean:1301, :1309). Second place, one built course only: SignLoop.refuted_* (as under S3). Third place, laws: ReadingSchedule.keeps_iff_within (:879): with (a + ℓ)·d ≤ m < (a + 1 + ℓ)·d, a schedule keeps c within the margin m against every balanced flow's draws of at most d a step withdrawn ℓ steps after a reading exactly where it reads c within every a steps. Regulation.no_narrower_band (Regulation.lean:886): a rule reading ℓ steps late keeps no band [a, b] with 0 < a narrower than 2(ℓ + 1)d against rests moving the level by at most d a step.
per_sentence.handed_in: The schedule, the lateness ℓ, the bound d on the draw, the margin, and that a reading withdraws the drawer; in Regulation the rule and how late it reads.
per_sentence.say_it_so: No statement says the places are three, or separate. Holding to something can itself keep a difference from being registered (alike_of_kept, ReadingLoop.lean:508). A reader with time to spare can still fail to keep three conditions (spare_not_enough, ReadingSchedule.lean:898). A level read and acted on can be overshot without end (Regulation.never_at_of_beyond :285, relay_threshold :1989). 'In time' is exact for one reader: within every a steps, a the largest with (a + ℓ)·d at most the margin; each step of lateness shortens every window by one.

per_sentence.sentence: S6. From a reading an account of the world is drawn. It can be right about what is registered; taken for the whole, it says more than the reading can know.
per_sentence.grade: a theorem states part of it
per_sentence.by: PartialReadout.SoundWithin.silent (PartialReadout.lean:133): a reading sound within a domain proposes nothing at a value where the map merges two configurations of the domain with different feature values. exact_exists_iff (:126): given a section of the map over the domain, some exact reading exists exactly where the feature is lumped within it. One built channel: direct_exact_unreversed (:236) with direct_not_sound (:242): the direct reading is exact on the unreversed channels and not sound on all. Readout.reading_single_iff (Readout.lean:63). ReadingLoop.everything_kept and nothing_kept (ReadingLoop.lean:258, :268): being kept is not being informative. Loop.kept_alike (:624): the loop's model lumps the candidates its own course does not tell apart.
per_sentence.handed_in: The map, the feature, the domain and the answer function; a section of the map where existence is concluded. No statement has an account being drawn from a reading as a step of a course, except the candidates kept in Loop.law.
per_sentence.say_it_so: Sharper in the Lean: an account that stays right is silent wherever its reading merges two cases of what it speaks of; one that speaks there is wrong in one of them. An account exact on a domain exists exactly where the reading merges no two cases of that domain that differ in it.

per_sentence.sentence: S8. Where many act on such an account it can make itself so, and what it leaves out can be used up while nothing they register differs.
per_sentence.grade: a theorem states part of it
per_sentence.by: ReadingLoop.Loop.rests_of_unrefuted (ReadingLoop.lean:672): where the world answers the act chosen with the value sensed and stays, the loop chooses that act from the candidates listed, and every listed candidate predicts that answer, the loop rests at once: the same candidates, act and value at every step. Untested.alike_in_both (:828), never_high (:842), true_kept (:820): in a built pair of worlds the loop keeps both candidates, one of them false of the world it is in, and never senses the value that would tell them apart. floor_forgoes (:889): so does every formation on those worlds that never senses the low value. SignLoop.rests_unread (HeldForReading.lean:1301): listing only gain and going on, the course is the same whatever the true sign. For 'used up while not registered': ReadingSchedule.loses_of_unread (:690).
per_sentence.handed_in: The listing, the choice rule, the world's answers. One loop, not many; in the built worlds the world does not move, so nothing is used up there.
per_sentence.say_it_so: In this family the account does not make itself so. It stays unrefuted: the acts chosen by it never meet the answer that would refute it, and it can be false. That is a second way to S8's, and the understanding has no sentence for it.

per_sentence.sentence: S9. It need not: an account acted on comes true only where the response to it is the account again, and some defeat themselves.
per_sentence.grade: a theorem states part of it
per_sentence.by: ReadingLoop.Loop.kept_iff (ReadingLoop.lean:589) is the exact condition for an account to stay under its own course: kept exactly where every value sensed after the acts taken is what it predicted. SignLoop.refuted_drops (HeldForReading.lean:1324): an account dropped by the answer to an act the loop took.
per_sentence.handed_in: As under S8.
per_sentence.say_it_so: The part carried here is about an account staying, not about its coming true: 'right exactly where the response is itself' is family C's (ReflexivePrediction.Right). In this family a false account can be kept beside the true one. Nothing here has an account that defeats itself by being acted on; the dropped account in SignLoop was false before the act.

per_sentence.sentence: S10. The case most wanted: more is taken than comes back, and nothing that registers this can still turn how the loop is set (a closing).
per_sentence.grade: a theorem states part of it
per_sentence.by: The two halves are in two carriers and no statement has them together. Taking with nothing given while unread, and the loss that follows: ReadingSchedule.loses_of_unread (:690). Nothing reaching how the loop is set: Pace.rule_unreached (Pace.lean:188): where no step reads, two courses from one rule, whatever their fast configurations, have the same rule at every step; never_reads_lost (:195).
per_sentence.handed_in: The schedule in both; that it never reads is a premise, not an outcome.

per_sentence.sentence: S12. Where what is used up is what others rest on and the loop does not, it can go on without end while they lose it for good.
per_sentence.grade: a theorem states part of it
per_sentence.by: ReadingSchedule.loses_of_unread (:690) and the witness inside within_of_keeps (:848; Drawer.flow :784, Drawer.web :790): the part that draws on c requires nothing; another formation requires c and is the one lost. The definition Keeps (:732) is about exactly this: whatever has significance without the drawer is retained.
per_sentence.handed_in: The draw, the schedule, the margin. Not carried: 'without end' (the witness draws for finitely many steps and is withdrawn after a reading) and 'for good'.

per_sentence.sentence: S14. Many readings that all miss it close as well; one reading that reaches it can turn in time.
per_sentence.grade: a theorem states part of it
per_sentence.by: Second half, exact for one reader that only withdraws: ReadingSchedule.keeps_iff_within (:879), with density (:265), no_two_three (:278) and spare_not_enough (:898) on how many conditions one reader can so keep, and keeps_of_half (:912). Laws that qualify it: Learning.twin_selected (Unread.lean:104): where no read occasion shares the unread occasion's lump, every selection through agreement on the read occasions that selects an act law also selects one agreeing with it on every reading and taking any other value there. ReadStages.complyThenOwn_realized_iff (ReadStages.lean:524), complyThenOwn_best_iff (:323), twin_complyThenOwn (:543). SignLoop.rests_unread (HeldForReading.lean:1301): a stop is there as the answer to an act the course never takes.
per_sentence.handed_in: The schedule, lateness, draw and margin; the formation's lumping of occasions; the prospects (weights, value, loss).
per_sentence.say_it_so: One reading that reaches it turns it in time where three more things hold: it reads within the window the margin allows; what it then does comes within the lateness; and the loop that is read cannot tell being read from not being read, or holds its act for the reader. Without the last, a reader fixes what it reads and nothing else. The expectation named ClosedCapture.turned_by_loss and ReadInTime for this half; ReadingSchedule holds it with an exact window and was not named.

per_sentence.sentence: S15. One value taken for what one is, and given in to, is a closing inside one loop; so is folding everything back onto the self.
per_sentence.grade: a theorem states part of it
per_sentence.by: HeldForReading.held_gains_iff (HeldForReading.lean:541): for a model listing candidates with natural-number weights, and a gain and a loss of going on at each, holding for the reading that tells the candidate stands above both going on and switching off exactly where some candidate of positive weight has going on lose and some has it gain. excess_pos_iff (:921); SignLoop.choose_go_ties (:1474) and rests_unread (:1301): a listing that fixes the sign never holds and never senses the stop. Outside the five families: ListingValuation.own_least (ListingValuation.lean:996): judged by the reading formation's own current valuation, with one shared model and the map's cells listed once and covering the listing, no rule through the map stands higher than its current answer. revalued_lowers_iff (:1008): a revaluation lowers that worth exactly where it decides some listed cell against the current valuation's strict weighted preference. outcome_least (:1023) and no_order_across (:1726): after a revaluation the new answer is again least by the new valuation, and no order across valuations follows. For 'folding back onto the self' only a head note in this family: Readings.lean lines 41 to 52 restate Boundaries' bounded_invariant_iff.
per_sentence.handed_in: Weights, values, the scale, the rule of stopping, that holding costs nothing; the valuation's update.
per_sentence.say_it_so: What is proved is in counts and about an account or a valuation, not about 'what one is': an account that gives weight to one outcome only gains nothing, on that account, from being stoppable; and judged by its own present valuation, every revision that changes a decision is a loss. That second law is the nearest thing in the Lean to why one value closes, and it is in none of the five families.

per_sentence.sentence: S16. No top is expected: what a loop holds to is set by slower loops, and those by others.
per_sentence.grade: a theorem states part of it
per_sentence.by: Two levels only: Pace.paced (Pace.lean:112), rule_at_reading (:266): at a reading step the next rule is what h gives from the fast configuration there; rule_until_reading (:247): if no step before r reads, the rule is the start's at every step up to and including r. pace_law (:539): given two values, a stretch of L steps fixes every pair of courses with at most N states that held rules generate exactly when L ≥ 2N − 1; dissolving (:420); never_reads_loses (:213). A value revised by another formation's input: ListingValuation.TwoWorlds.presented_turns (:2247), one built course. Beside these, Regulation.Flow.stock_settles (Regulation.lean:469): under balance, where each condition of a family is within the gap and opposing towards its own level from T on, the family's stock is the total of those levels from a late enough step, with nothing reading the stock.
per_sentence.handed_in: h (what the slower level makes of what it reads) and the schedule of reading steps; Pace's head note (lines 72 to 74) says which rule a slow level reads into, and that it reads at any stretch, are not derived. ListingValuation's revalue and the holder's schedule. There is no third level and no statement about a top.
per_sentence.say_it_so: The Lean has the two-level form and is sharper on 'slower': never changing, a rule loses what its law merges and regains nothing; changing more often than every 2N − 1 steps, the course it holds cannot be told from its own stretch. In Pace the setting runs both ways: the slower sets what the faster goes by, from what the faster meets. And stock_settles is a case the sentence leaves out: a total held with nothing above setting or reading it, from parts each held at its own level.

per_sentence.sentence: S17. Below there are goings-on that hold to nothing, of which conditions hold with no one valuing; how holding to something comes about among them is derived in no model.
per_sentence.grade: a theorem states part of it
per_sentence.by: First clause: Reading.reading_glue (Reading.lean:239): for every law of exchange, with the rest counted and activity, drawing and requirement read off the law, the flow balances, only active relata give and take, and activity needs support, with no premise; ExchangeLaw.unresponsive (:269) is a law that responds to nothing, and the same holds of it. Sensitivity.least_coupling (Sensitivity.lean:197). Last clause: head notes only, and I found nothing in the family against it: HeldForReading line 14 (values, weights and rules supplied, how they form not derived), ReadingLoop lines 122 to 123, Regulation line 73, ListingValuation lines 17 to 18; the set level is a field of ReaderRebuilding.Rule (:75) that never changes.
per_sentence.handed_in: Every held-to in the family: m, s, K, a ranking, values and weights, prospects, a valuation's update.

per_sentence.sentence: S18. Of each loop the same is asked: does what it rests on, and what it uses up that others rest on, still reach how it reads, early enough to turn it?
per_sentence.grade: a theorem states part of it
per_sentence.by: The question has an exact answer in two settings. ReadingSchedule.keeps_iff_within (:879), which is about what others rest on (see S12). ReadingLoop.keeps_continues_iff (ReadingLoop.lean:231): with a reading kept by the update under every act, a policy keeps a task at every configuration reached from a sound one and goes on from each exactly where each state's act can be taken at every world its reading admits and leads only where the task holds; history_keeps_iff (:394) for a policy acting from its own history. On when a difference can reach how a loop is set: Pace.rule_alike_until_reading (Pace.lean:260).
per_sentence.handed_in: As under S5 and S2.

per_sentence.sentence: S19. An argument that uses only what a reading registers cannot show what is running down; something has to be brought in.
per_sentence.grade: a theorem states it
per_sentence.by: Readout.judges_iff_lumpedOn (Readout.lean:274): for a listed family, a reduction π with equality of reduced values decided, and an observable f, a judge reading only the reduced value gives f at every member exactly where f goes alike across the members π merges. no_judge_of_merged (:283): so none exists where π merges two members f tells apart. lumped_of_decodes (:73) without a list. PartialReadout.signal_no_exact (PartialReadout.lean:224) with paired_exact (:213): in one built channel no reading of the signal alone is exact, and the signal with a reference reading is. Of a selection: Learning.twin_selected (Unread.lean:104). Of a loop: ReadingLoop.alike_of_kept (:508).
per_sentence.handed_in: The reduction and the observable; in the channel, the reference reading.
per_sentence.say_it_so: The sentence lacks its premise, and the law is two-sided. Where a reading merges two cases that differ in what is running down, no argument from what it registers alone can say which holds; where it merges none, one can. What has to be brought in is something that tells those two cases apart. And where telling them apart would break what the loop holds to, a loop that keeps holding cannot bring it in itself: it has to come from outside its course (Untested.informed_turns, ReadingLoop.lean:992) or cost the floor once (explorer_low_once :873).

per_sentence.sentence: S20. An account can become the next single measure. What keeps it from closing is that a case, a failed test or a reader who disagrees can still turn it.
per_sentence.grade: a theorem states part of it
per_sentence.by: A failed test: Loop.kept_iff (ReadingLoop.lean:589): a candidate that mispredicts an answer taken in is not kept. A reader who can stop it, one built loop with three courses: SignLoop.both_stopped (HeldForReading.lean:1340) and both_off (:1375): listing both signs and holding first, where going on loses the loop is off from step two; refuted_goes_on (:1332): listing gain alone and holding first, it senses the stop, drops its only candidate and goes on; rests_unread (:1301): going on from the start it never meets the stop. HeldForReading.threshold_go_iff (:840): holding for a rule, forgoing an amount, stands at least as high as going on exactly where the rule's shortfall and the amount together are at most the excess of switching off.
per_sentence.handed_in: The listing, the default with nothing kept, values and weights. The first sentence of S20 (an account becoming the single measure) is not in this family.

res.smallest_join_worth_stating:
AI-written; argued on paper, not compiled, not built.

The statement, in Reading.lean's and Counterfactual.lean's definitions as they stand (Sensitivity.lean is the module about the second):

theorem ExchangeLaw.sensitive_of_responds [DecidableEq C] {law : ExchangeLaw F C} {present : Nat → List F} {l : Nat → C → Nat} {t : Nat} {f : F} {c : C} {n : Nat} (exchanges : law.ExchangesUnder present l t f) (responds : law.RespondsBelow present l t f c n) (positive : 0 < n) : law.Sensitive f c

In words: where a formation exchanges across a step, and its exchange there responds to a condition falling below a positive need, its exchange is sensitive to that condition. On the web read off the law (ExchangeLaw.readWeb, Reading.lean:217) this says: what an active formation requires at a positive need is among what makes a difference to its exchange. With Sensitivity.least_coupling (Sensitivity.lean:197), for a law reading finitely many conditions every coupling it reads through then holds that condition, up to double negation.

Proof on paper: let l' be l with c's level at t set to 0. It differs from l only there, and 0 < n, so by responds the formation does not exchange under l'. If the law were insensitive to c at t, it would give alike under l and l', which agree on every other condition up to t, and so the formation would exchange under l' as under l. About ten lines; equality of conditions has to be decided to build l'.

Why it may be worth stating: it settles how the first line of the direction page can be said in the Lean's own terms. With requiring read off the law, what a formation requires cannot fall outside what makes a difference to it; the gap is between what it draws on and what its exchange is sensitive to, and between whether a level makes a difference at all and at which levels it does. The kept witness of the gap is already there: ExchangeLaw.unresponsive (Reading.lean:269; unresponsive_unrequired :298) draws on its condition at every step and is sensitive to nothing.

What would count against it:
- Each premise is needed. A law that never exchanges responds below every need and is sensitive to nothing; a need of 0 is vacuous.
- It is only about requirement read off the law. In a Web, requires is a field; where it is supplied apart from the law (the witnesses of World.independent, as Reading.lean's head note describes them) the statement does not apply, and that is where the direction's gap lives.
- By the map's own measure it counts as nothing: it is near-definitional, it joins two modules that have no dynamic in the atlas, and no older proof becomes a case or loses a line. Its use is for the wording of the direction page and of S4, not for the count of links.

Two others, larger, for the record. (a) ReaderRebuilding's open item cut_ends as a case of TurningInTime.ends_with_net was proposed in the day's regulation try and recommended by its refuter; I add nothing to it. (b) Giving ReadingLoop.Loop.law as an instance of ReadingLoop.joint would make Loop.fitting_closed (ReadingLoop.lean:644) a case of closed_of_keptBy (:171) and join the module's two atlas dynamics; the head note names it as not done, and the obstacle is timing (the Loop takes an answer in one step after sensing it). Not small.

res.five_sentences: AI-written. Since 30 October the Lean has a loop that senses, predicts, chooses, acts and revises as one law, and proves of it that which differences in the world can reach it depends on the acts it takes, and that a loop which keeps what it holds to never comes to tell apart worlds that differ only where telling would break it. What the loop takes the world to be is in the state with its course derived, but what it holds to and the distinction it acts by are handed in everywhere, except in one module outside the five families (ListingValuation), where the valuation is in the state and its update is handed in. 'In time' is exact in two places: one reader keeps a condition exactly where it reads it within a window fixed by the margin, the draw and the lateness, and cannot keep everything even with time to spare; and a rule that reads late keeps no band narrower than twice the lateness plus one, times the step. A reading is itself kept up and has a price: in one family of models a reader rebuilt from the level it keeps lasts as long as the stock and, once gone, never returns, and holding an act for a reader is worth something on a loop's own account only where that account gives weight to both outcomes. None of this is joined by a law to this month's lock, level and line (the lock is only written on Pace's two-level course), only five of the nineteen modules have a dynamic in the atlas, and five sentences need saying differently: S4, S19, S14 with S20, S8 with S9, and S5.

res.against_or_missing_from_the_understandin:
No sentence is contradicted by a statement of this family. Seven sentences have to be said with a premise the Lean has (S4, S5, S7, S8, S12, S13, S14) and S18 with a distinction it has. Nothing was built or compiled for this read; every 'proved' below rests on the modules being imported by Becoming.lean and on their own head notes.

AGAINST THE UNDERSTANDING AS A WHOLE

1. The laws here select on what an act does to what comes back, not on what a reading covers. S13 and S14 say a reading 'misses' or 'reaches' what is taken, as if coverage decided. In line_standing_unselected (ReadingsPersist.lean:459) and standingCount_unselected (ReadingsSpread.lean:455), a reading that counts the neighbour and one that leaves it out stand late alike, and hold the same share, wherever their acts agree on everything coupled into the lines' closure. The head note's own words are that persistence selects 'an act's trace on what returns to the line, not a scope' (ReadingsPersist.lean:112-120). In the built commons the share of the reading that leaves the neighbour out rises by selection proper, from one of three to two of three (Commons.cleared_spreads, ReadingsSpread.lean:1133). So where the taking feeds the taker and the loss lies beyond its closure, selection by share favours the narrowing (one built world) and is indifferent to anything beyond the closure (law). The understanding has no sentence for this.

2. Against two of the writer's expectations. 'S11 and S12 are said of no loop that reads' does not hold here: both are shown, since 9 and 10 November, of lines carrying readings, with a reading being a label for a supplied act. 'No new link' needs the two qualifications given under the links: Flow.carriers_drawn_down, and TurningInTime section 7's use of this family's point of no return, are laws on main that the atlas does not show as edges.

WHAT THE UNDERSTANDING HAS NO SENTENCE FOR

a. A count over whoever is left. survivorsPersist_of_settled (ReadingsPersist.lean:569): a selection read off the pool its own course gives passes every settled course whatever was removed, its own line included (Habitat.clearedBack_survivors_pass, :1357). Read off a list fixed beforehand, every removal turns it (not_allPersist_of_removes, :578). This is a closing in which no one is silenced.

b. Margin. A difference that has arrived is read only once it crosses the reader's margin (admits_iff_gap_within_margin, ReadOffInTime.lean:568). A reader whose own continuation is part of what is to be kept is always late (too_late_of_own, :743; its two premises are that every course that keeps admits every member at every step, and that the other course does).

c. Reading in time is not turning, and the turn takes a step. See S18: T < N here, T + 1 < N in TurningInTime, with TurningInTime.Three as a kept case of read-before-the-point that ends.

d. The loss can fall on a third line. In Commons.clearedBack_ends (ReadingsSpread.lean:1180) the wide line, which reads everything and took nothing from the habitat, is removed with the taker.

e. Spreading and lasting are apart. The four narrow courses of the commons share their counts for three steps and then have four fates; the head note says how long a narrow reading spreads is how long what feeds it lasts.

f. The same blindness twice. A selection by share registers nothing that all its carriers do alike (concord_uniform, fixed_step). This has the form of S7's position (RelativePosition.keeps_iff_common, another family). The understanding has S7 for position and S13 for narrowing and does not say they are one blindness. No Lean statement joins them either.

g. In these modules a selection is a predicate that nothing keeps up; it passes even its own line's ending. The direction page's fourth paragraph calls that sentence shape the trap. It is the shape of this family's Lean.

h. 'Reading' is three unjoined things here: a label carried at descent that picks an act (ReadingsPersist, ReadingsSpread); what an act's exchange depends on (coupling, from BeyondCoupling); a predicate on courses read off a group's admissions (ReadOffInTime). In ReadingsSpread what is 'sensed' is another member's label, not a level.

res.smallest_join_worth_stating:
First choice, inside the family, for S10 with S13: removal closes.

In the two modules' own definitions: let `lines : List I` with `slotsOf : I -> X -> Prop`, a web W, generations G with `G.RevisesBy read (fun t g => read (src t g)) upd`, and a region `inR : Sig -> Bool`.

Premises:
- stands: each member's source stands at its step, from some step on (closedFrom_of_standing's own premise).
- keeps: upd of two readings in the region lies in it (also its own).
- others: every relatum whose reading lies outside the region is a slot of a listed line.
- removes: `RemovesLine slotsOf W.level i` for every listed i.

Conclusion: there is a T with `G.ClosedFrom read (fun t g => read (src t g)) upd (fun s => inR s = true) T`. Where the members of each cohort stand, every member of every cohort from T on carries the region.

It adds to Flow.closedFrom_of_standing only the step from RemovesLine to its premise `carried` (T is the latest of the lines' steps; a standing relatum outside the region would make a removed line alive). That is exactly the step the atlas edge and the head note already claim and no statement has.

What would count against it:
1. No course generated by acts meets it. The one generated world with a spreading narrow reading fails `others` with `removes`: in Commons.cleared the wide line persists carrying another reading, and the commons' readings are inherited. So it would join two definitions and no world.
2. It shortens no existing proof. Contact.removed_locked goes through fixed_of_present directly.
3. A reader may hold it to be two theorems side by side: closedFrom_of_standing and the unpacking of RemovesLine.

Second, kept as a countermodel and not as a join: read before the point of no return, and not turned. On TurningInTime.Three, give the level a gauge needing 7. Against the course held at nine it is first apart at step 2. The course as it was is recoverable at step 2 (Three.noReturn, TurningInTime.lean:2457). So ReadOffInTime's ReadableInTime holds, while the pair marked at six ends (Three.turned_and_ends, :2405). Only the ReadableInTime instance is missing; it needs a web on one condition, which is an instance and not a new structure. It would show ReadableInTime (T < N) and turning in time (T + 1 < N) apart. Against it: one may say the difference is only where each model puts the step of the response, a convention and not a finding.

res.five_sentences:
1. Since 9 and 10 November the Lean has lines that carry a reading, meaning a label that fixes how they act, with a law that such a line goes on alike under two readings whose acts differ only in what never comes back to it; in two built worlds a line whose reading leaves a neighbour out takes what the neighbour needs and goes on without end while the neighbour is lost for good, and where the neighbour had been renewing its source it ends too, along with a bystander that took nothing.
2. A count taken over whoever is still there registers no removal on any course that settles, not even its own ending, while the same count over a list fixed beforehand is turned by every removal.
3. The share of a kind of reading moves by who leaves more offspring and by revision; once every member carries that kind, each newcomer's reading is revised only from those present, and revising among them stays within the kind, it stays, selection by share then registers nothing, and only a reading taken from outside changes it.
4. For a group of readers of whom only 'is its need met' is read, there is an exact condition for a loss to be readable in time (the first step at which the two courses differ in some reader's need being met must come before the first step from which no course still open keeps what is asked); in the built world one reader of four is in time, the one that needs more than what it protects, a reader of only its own continuation is always late, and whether a reading turns the course, or which way, is not stated.
5. None of it derives how a reading or its act comes about (readings, acts, updates, what is sensed and who counts as a reader are all handed in), and this month's models use of this family only one lemma on descent, the count of the born, and the point of no return of a course, not its laws on readings.

res.five_sentences: How a distinction is drawn, merged, imposed and kept among many holders is stated exactly for codes: taking forms from one another makes no new form, a form all hold stays under every order and rule, a merged distinction comes back only from a form kept outside or newly coined, and many come to one from every start exactly where the order of hearing gives all one origin. What survives a change in what is told apart is stated in general: every selection through the old reading survives exactly where the new one merges nothing the old told apart, nothing read off a reading opens a correction the reading did not, and in one built process forming a distinction is a move that draws on the same stock as acting on it. Of an account that is acted on: for one published value "right" is defined as the response giving it back, some responses leave none right, and reaching a right one is proved only from the bottom under a response that keeps the order; for records each cohort rewrites, an account is given back for ever whether or not it was right about what the first records bore on, unless the earlier records are kept. An answer drawn through what has reached a reader cannot differ between two courses whose difference has not reached it by the time it answers, a verdict bounded by a region is the whole's exactly as far as nothing that can be lost lies outside, and no statement about the dynamics alone entails what has significance. None of this is joined to a level being used up or to this month's models; every value, goal and acceptability in it is handed in; the module called Closing is about a different thing from the understanding's closing; and a tower of rules with no top is defined and shown to allow nothing that some top held would not also allow.

res.against_or_missing_from_the_understandin:
AI-written; a reading of statements and docstrings, nothing built or proved by me.

1. Seen and still drained. The five paragraphs put the trouble at a gap between what a loop rests on and what makes a difference to it, where things run down unseen. The drawers laws have a running down with nothing unseen: every rule reads the step and what it is given, every drawer counts the need being met, and every best-response profile drains (Coupled.drains_below 367, gated_threshold 774, AtOnce.unpivotal_drain_perfect 853, Shores.drain_perfect 1026; without the count, InTurn.position_perfect_ends, Optimum 8686; in the tested season, Season.after_drained 613, where the bay is counted after the catch and every optimum empties it). What decides is how much the need is counted against what taking brings (the threshold is the need itself), whether any one drawer can leave the need alone, and whether there is one drawer or several (one_keeps_several_drain 692: at the same count one keeps and several in turn drain). The understanding has no sentence for a rate, for being pivotal, or for one against many. Its account of Moloch as taking plus a closing of the reading leaves this out.

2. Selection for a rise rewards taking from beyond. S8 says what is left out can be used up. SelectionReach says more, as a necessity: where nothing comes from nothing across a step, every selection that holds only where what a group couples into rises holds only where something no member couples into is taken (Flow.favours_reaching_beyond 254; Diversion.supplying_raises_untaken 346 shows the premise is needed). No sentence of the understanding says this.

3. Reaching does not fix the direction. Clearing.read_not_direction (BeyondCoupling 521) keeps the failed candidate; Diversion.counting_selected_against (574) is a selection through the taker's couplings that holds at the act that ends the dweller and fails at refraining. S14 and S18 read as if reaching in time turns toward keeping.

4. What a pool adds is difference, and reading the actor is not it. pool_adds and pooled_iff_member (SelectionPool 200, 189); Web.anticipates_iff (508); Clearing.reading_clearer_unselected (791) against reading_dweller_selects (816). For oversight this says: reading a system's internal states pools with the system and reaches no further; what closes the gap is a coupling to what the act reaches.

5. Calling something a loop that reads is itself a reading. BlanketCouplings: every family of courses is the course family of a four-part law if the parts may read the course (clocked_course 557), and a constant map gives every family one (const_consistent 652); only a partition fixed apart from the family can be refuted (ReadsExternal.not_blanketed 746). S1's 'for some goings-on' carves nothing unless the partition is fixed before the courses are seen. The understanding does not say this.

6. Ending and loss are two statements (Clearing.loss_needs_significance, RelativePosition 859); see S12.

7. Position reads amounts, not rank, and it does read something of the total: a least, never a most (exceeds_iff_spread 349). Read on a step it certifies that more is taken than given exactly where the spread of the takes does (Flow.excess_iff_spread 469). Over a whole course the selection term is not blind to fate either: positive at unboundedly many steps, every generation is nonempty (SelectionShift never_empties_of_unbounded 337).

8. The atlas lists as open, under position-does-not-protect, that a race for position produces joint excess. Optimum's race gives something else: one fall to what grows back from nothing, then standing there (position_levels 8720), and the break of a dependence above that (Web.position_broken 9197). The two atlas entries on position do not refer to each other, and RelativePosition is imported by no module; its laws are used by none.

On the writer's expectations. S7's second half is not ours; it is RelativePosition's and SelectionShift's. S4 is carried here, S5's first place is this family's central law, S2 and S17 are carried in part by LevelCoupling: 'S1 to S5, S16 and S17 are carried nowhere' does not hold. S12 is said of something that reads in one built world. S14's second half has statements here as well as in the lock's family, and statements against reading it as enough. The last expectation holds as far as this family goes: no declaration of family D is used by TurningInTime, LineOnAStock or RegimeMargin.

res.smallest_join_worth_stating:
AI-written, not proved in Lean. The selection term proper reads offspring numbers exactly up to position:

theorem keeps_iff_same_terms [DecidableEq α] {ps : List α} {w w' : α → Nat} :
    RelativePosition.Keeps ps w w' ↔
      ∀ a : α → Nat, SelectionTerm.concord ps w a = SelectionTerm.concord ps w' a ∧
                     SelectionTerm.discord ps w a = SelectionTerm.discord ps w' a

In words: two profiles of weights give every member the same position exactly where they have the same concordance and the same discordance with every amount. Both sides' definitions as they stand (Keeps, RelativePosition 269; concord and discord, SelectionTerm 193, 197), no new structure, no premise.

How it would go. Left to right: keeps_iff_common (RelativePosition 276) gives w p + w' q = w q + w' p for members, so each excess (w p) (w q) is unchanged. Right to left: SelectionTerm.covariation (240) at the amount that is one at p and nothing elsewhere gives, for each profile, the number of members times w p, with the discordance, equal to the total weight with the concordance (times how often p is listed); equal terms then give the equality that Keeps asks. A throwaway script found no mismatch on 4,000 random small families, lists with repetition included. A search is not a proof.

Why this one. It joins S7 to what the direction page calls selection: the unequal-continuing relation gets its own exact law of alikeness, and what it cannot read, an amount common to all, is exactly what shift_step (SelectionShift 263) shows moves the size of the next generation. It gives RelativePosition, which no module imports, its first use, and LineOnAStock already carries a SelectionTerm.Generations. SelectionShift's concord_shifted and discord_shifted (165-183) would become its case at keeps_add (RelativePosition 306).

What would count against it. It does not compile constructively as stated (the mark needs decidable equality on members; without it the right-to-left half may fail). No line falls in SelectionShift or RelativePosition: then by the day's own bar it is a link and not a simplification. It is a law of one step: over a whole course, terms positive at unboundedly many steps do force going on (never_empties_of_unbounded, 337), so it must not be told as 'selection is blind to fate'. Position here is by amounts; it says nothing of rank.

Two smaller ones, not proposed first. (a) The race's outcome in position's own terms: under PerfectPosition, two or more drawers and what stands from nothing least, every drawer but the first draws nothing over the steps that remain, so the first is RelativePosition.Greatest; from drawn_first_none, drawn_other_none (Optimum 8600, 8609) and position_perfect_draws (8713). It would join the two atlas entries on position, which today share a docstring. (b) LineOnAStock.after_alike as Web.ReadOffContinuations for a web whose needs are the line's; the direction page already calls that join thin.

res.five_sentences: A selection that goes by what reaches a selector treats alike any two courses that are alike in what reaches it and can tell apart exactly those that are not, so an act whose difference stays beyond what reaches the selector, or a whole pool of selectors, is never selected for or against, whatever it ends out there; this has been proved since October, given that the others follow one law of exchange and both courses balance. A pool of readers reaches no further than its members do together, reading the actor more closely or knowing its law adds nothing, and what closes the gap is a member that the act does change, which then lies beyond the actor's own reach; even so the direction is not fixed, and a majority can outvote the one who sees it. Of position the package proves that rises total falls whatever anyone does, that position is unchanged when all gain or all lose the same amount, so that it gives a least for what all have together and no most, and it has one built world in which the same positions go with everything lasting and with everything ended. Of many who draw on one stock it proves that those ranking position draw everything, and that drawers who each count the need being met still drain it unless that count outweighs the need itself, or, drawing at once, at any count where none can leave the need alone, while one drawer in their place keeps it: a running down with nothing unseen, for which the evening's understanding has no sentence. In none of this does anything come to register or hold to anything, since what reaches whom and what each ranks are handed in; none of it is used by this month's three models; and the module on position is used by no other module at all.

res.five_sentences: Since October the Lean has had a loop whose rule is set again, at reading steps, from the share its own selection gave: where that reading rises with the share and favours, the loop locks, a rule or a reading corrected once is set back at the next reading, and it stays locked while a loss nothing in it reads grows without bound. It says how such a lock comes about: the capacity to set the rule spreads exactly where what comes back to its carriers alone covers its cost, whatever comes to everyone alike, and with readers drawn from those the rule selects there is a critical mass above which the capacity and the lock rise together. It says which ways out are proved: a lock is left only by a reading step that reads otherwise than the share-readers do or by a fall of the favoured share; a reading of the loss by the others turns it exactly while they still outweigh the favoured where the rule is set, and after a deadline the same reading keeps it; in one built course a loss falling on the favoured ends the lock with no one reading it, while a loss falling on the others keeps it. It says two things the evening's understanding does not: the taking can itself remove those who would read it, so that a stronger lock loses its readers sooner, and a turn leaves a loop locked the other way, not an open one. Of all this, this month's theorems use only the definition of the lock, one lemma that a step keeps it, and the definition of the window; the laws on who reads, when, and on whom the loss falls stand beside them, on a loss that is a counter nothing needs, and there in time is measured against the share and the readers, not against the stock.

It puts S7 and the direction's sentence on selection under one law: what the selection term cannot read is an amount common to all, which is where how much is left for all lies, and SelectionShift.shift_step (:263) already shows that amount moving the size of the next generation. It meets the four conditions as stated (both sides' definitions, no new structure, no premise). It would join two atlas entries that do not name each other (position-does-not-protect, the-selection-term-and-a-lineages-fate) and give RelativePosition, which only the root file imports, its first use. SelectionShift's concord_shifted and discord_shifted (:165, :175) would become its case at keeps_add.

How far seen. I checked the outline by hand against the definitions (RelativePosition.lean:269 to 276, SelectionTerm.lean:193 to 240). Left to right: keeps_iff_common gives w p + w' q = w q + w' p for members, so each excess is unchanged. Right to left: covariation at the amount that is one at p and nothing elsewhere gives, for each profile, the number of members times w p counted as often as p is listed, with the discordance, equal to the total weight counted as often, with the concordance; equal terms then give the count Keeps asks. Reader D reports a random search over 4,000 small families with no mismatch. A search and a hand outline are not a proof.

What would count against it.
- It does not go through with decidable equality alone, so the right-to-left half would need more than the package allows itself.
- No line falls: if concord_shifted and discord_shifted are not shortened by it, it is a link said beside and not a simplification.
- It is taken for more than one step. Over a whole course the term is not blind to fate (never_empties_of_unbounded, SelectionShift.lean:337, not opened by me), so it must not be told as 'selection is blind to what all live on'.
- A reader judges it one piece of arithmetic in two vocabularies: that covariance depends on the weights only through their distance from the mean is a textbook fact. Then it joins two entries and teaches nothing new; its worth is the joining.
- It says nothing of order of rank, which S7's wording asks.

If only smallness counts, reader C's is smaller: SharedCodes' record of what a cohort resolved is a right prediction in ReflexivePrediction's sense, so that written_rests (SharedCodes.lean:1183) becomes reached_rests in one line. I did not choose it because 'right' there is only 'left as it is by the step', and told without omitted_rest it would be heard as 'true'.

Before either, three repairs cost nothing and are owed: the three atlas edges the Lean does not carry, the overtaken open item under turning-in-time, and the rewording of S4, S7, S9, S14 and S19 on the direction page, which waits for Ren to read it.
